# netbox_front_port_template (Resource)

Manages a NetBox front port template (`/api/dcim/front-port-templates/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_front_port_template" "example" {
  name = "example"
  type = "8p8c"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) {module} is accepted as a substitution for the module bay position when attached to a module type.
- `type` (String) Type. One of 63 valid NetBox choices (see the NetBox documentation).

### Optional

- `color` (String) Color. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `device_type_id` (Number) ID of the Device Type (`netbox_device_type`).
- `label` (String) Physical label. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `module_type_id` (Number) ID of the Module Type (`netbox_module_type`).
- `positions` (Number) Positions. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `rear_ports` (Attributes List) Rear Ports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rear_ports))

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--rear_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rear_ports`

Required:

- `position` (Number) Position.
- `rear_port` (Number) Rear Port.

Optional:

- `rear_port_position` (Number) Rear Port Position.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_front_port_template can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_front_port_template.example 123
```
